status_policy.production_visible_requires: Exact deployed revision and functional evidence, beyond code presence or CI alone.
status_policy.historical_scope: ECHS-001–014 remain verified only for their original acceptance, not the expanded charter.
status_policy.board_snapshot: In-flight tasks remain unverified until a later evidence-backed board update. The board cannot contain its own future commit hash.

execution_order.policy: Parallel source work may proceed on independent owned files; merge/deploy one coherent tested slice at a time.

incremental-preservation-v1: Audit actual main before implementation; preserve original content/URLs/auth/publication gates, curriculum pins and rollback.
No current-cohort curriculum change without reviewed authoritative versioned records.
Add meaningful regression/failure tests, record scope and exact deployed functional evidence; no private source/answer/student payloads in public artifacts.
math-component-v1: Versioned model independent of renderer, validated schema, authoring preset and lazy runtime through ECHS-016 registry.
Independent mathematical oracles: domains, assumptions, units, exact/approximate results, singularities/endpoints/rounding and all linked representations.
Keyboard/labels/focus/non-color state, reduced motion, accessible static fallback, reset, resize and disposal; declared school-device performance budget.
Student changes mathematically meaningful state and investigates outcomes; no mastery from viewing, revealing or manipulating.
learning-sequence-v1: See → manipulate → predict → explain → symbolize → apply → remove scaffold → original static AP/IB task → authenticated evidence.
A contextual/visual variation preserves target skill, rigor and exam command expectations.
spatial-mathematics-v1: Safe parsed model independent of WebGL; lazily imported Three.js through the shared registry, with no heavy global dependency.

Disk/washer synchronize 2D region, selected x/y/x=k/y=k axis, movable representative slice, geometric R/r, thickness, 2D/3D cross-section, area, differential volume, integral and resulting solid. Radius is distance to the axis, never an assumed raw function value.
Shell synchronizes strip, radius, circumference, height, thickness, shell, differential volume and integral; useful exploded-shell mode has a mathematical purpose.
Known cross sections synchronize square/rectangle/equilateral triangle/semicircle or reviewed extension base, geometry, area, position and integral.

Watch and scrub generating-region rotation through 0/90/180/270/360 degrees; play, pause, slice, camera rotate/zoom/reset and axis/region/slice/label/formula toggles work without decorative continuous motion.
Build one/few/many slices toward the smooth solid and connect the approximation to Riemann sums.
Exact textual measurements/formulas, keyboard slice movement, reduced motion, 2D/static and WebGL-unavailable fallbacks remain meaningful.
Dispose geometries/materials/listeners, pause offscreen, adapt mesh resolution and provide a weak-device mode; measure repeated mount/unmount memory and frame budgets.

Independent math tests include shifted axes, domain crossing, inner/outer ordering, degenerate thickness, bounds and orientation. Finish with an original static AP setup/justification task with scaffold removed.
